name: Tampa

zoning_layer.note: City of Tampa GIS 'Zoning District' layer on the city's open data ArcGIS server. No key needed. ZONEDESC holds the long name. 55 distinct ZONECLASS values on 2026-11-17, including PD, PD-A, CBD, CD, YC, SH, NMU-35, M-AP and a few county codes (A, AS-1, CU).

overlay_layers.note: Local historic districts: Hyde Park, Seminole Heights, Tampa Heights, Ybor City. Names carry a trailing space.
National Register districts; fields not tested.
Overlay districts; CODE holds the code section (for example Sec. 27-240 East Tampa).
ADU eligible areas. CRITERIA is 'ADU Permitted', 'ADU - Special Use Required' or 'ADU Not Permitted'; NAME says which standards apply.

overlay_layers.why_page_size: Pages of 300 large flood polygons time out on the county server (tested 2026-11-19).
overlay_layers.note: Hillsborough County copy of the FEMA flood hazard zones effective 2022 (detailed). SFHA_TF marks the special flood hazard area.

Qualified Opportunity Zones designated in 2018 (8,765 census tracts on 2010 tract lines), from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development's copy of the Treasury (CDFI Fund) list. A lot is in a zone when its point is inside a designated 2010 tract. Designations run through 2028. build_region copies the tract number to parcel_site.opportunity_zone_2018. Verified 2026-11-26.

permit_source.note: City of Tampa 'Construction Inspections' layer: 2,588 rows on 2026-11-17 with record ID, record type, address, number of units (NBROFUNITS), new construction sq ft, status and created date. It lists current and recent projects, not a full history, and has no job value. A second layer, https://arcgis.tampagov.net/arcgis/rest/services/OpenData/Planning/MapServer/32 'Single Family Permits', has 1,045 rows, mostly 2025-2026. No free bulk permit history was found; the Accela portal (aca-prod.accela.com/TAMPA) is search-only.

disclaimer: Estimates, not tax, legal, zoning or appraisal advice.
